title: Spurs Media Usage — Demo
source: FICTIONAL. Written by the REROUTE team as hackathon demo data. No San Antonio Spurs, NBA, broadcaster or sponsor contract was supplied or consulted.
disclaimer: FICTIONAL DEMO POLICY — not an actual team, league, broadcaster or sponsor agreement. DEMO POLICY — NOT VERIFIED LEGAL CLEARANCE.

rules.explanation: NBA game footage is allowed in FR and US on Instagram and YouTube (editorial, organic or sponsored) until 31 Dec 2026.
Players, officials and arena signage in NBA game footage are cleared for club social posts.
Sponsored posts can't show a rival sponsor's branding (exclusivity). Reviewers flag it with the label brand:rival-sponsor.
NBA game footage can't be shown in GB — a broadcaster holds an exclusive window there.
Sponsored NBA footage can't be posted on TikTok.
